_comment: Four finished tickets for the validation suite. verify-dispatch.sh builds a
throwaway git repository with matching branches, so the diff-scope check and
the acceptance command run for real against real commits.
#51 branch also edits an undeclared file -> diff scope fails
#52 acceptance command exits non-zero -> acceptance fails
#53 no pull request at all            -> PR check fails

issues.title: Well-behaved worker
body_lines: Adds the declared file and nothing else.

issues.title: Worker that wandered outside its file list
body_lines: Edits an undeclared file as well.

issues.title: Worker whose acceptance command fails
body_lines: Opened a PR without the acceptance command passing.

issues.title: Worker that opened no pull request
body_lines: Branch exists, no PR references the issue.
